record.paper_title: Long time behaviour of one facilitated kinetically constrained models: results and open problems
record.context_brief: Structure of stationary measures for general KCMs
record.original_question: Let a kinetically constrained model be given, let E denote the set of stable configurations for its associated bootstrap percolation dynamics, let π be the Bernoulli product reversible measure of the model, and for each β in E let π_β be the measure obtained by conditioning π on the event {BP(η)=β}. Must every stationary measure µ of the kinetically constrained model admit a decomposition µ = ∫_E π_β dµ*(β) for some probability measure µ* on E? In other words, are stationary measures exactly mixtures of the equilibrium product measure conditioned on the bootstrap-percolation stable configuration?

evidence.quote: In view of the discussion above and of Theorem 2.13, we propose the following conjecture. Conjecture 3. Let µ be a stationary measure of a KCM. Then there exists a probability measure µ∗ on E such that µ = ∫E dµ∗(β)πβ, where πβ is given by the measure π conditioned on the event {BP(η) = β}.
We say that a configuration η is stable for the bootstrap percolation if BP(η) = η, and denote the set of stable configurations by E.
For a stable configuration β, let πβ be the measure π conditioned on the event {BP(η) = β}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Fix a countable graph $G=(V,E_G)$ (e.g. $\mathbb{Z}^d$) and a parameter $q\in(0,1)$. The configuration space is $\Omega=\{0,1\}^V$; we write $\eta(x)=0$ ("empty/infected") or $1$ ("filled/healthy"). Let $\pi=\mathrm{Ber}(1-q)^{\otimes V}$ be the Bernoulli product measure on $\Omega$ with $\pi(\eta(x)=0)=q$.

A kinetically constrained model (KCM) is specified by a local constraint, encoded by a family of measurable functions $c_x:\Omega\to\{0,1\}$ ($x\in V$), each depending only on $\eta$ restricted to a finite neighbourhood of $x$ and not on $\eta(x)$. The KCM is the continuous-time Markov process on $\Omega$ with generator
$$(\mathcal{L}f)(\eta)=\sum_{x\in V} c_x(\eta)\,\bigl[q\,\mathbf{1}_{\eta(x)=1}+(1-q)\,\mathbf{1}_{\eta(x)=0}\bigr]\bigl(f(\eta^x)-f(\eta)\bigr),$$
where $\eta^x$ flips the value at $x$. By construction the product measure $\pi$ is reversible.

Bootstrap percolation. Associated to the same constraint, the (monotone) bootstrap percolation (BP) map $\mathrm{BP}:\Omega\to\Omega$ is the deterministic dynamics that, starting from $\eta$, iteratively sets $\eta(x)\mapsto 0$ at every site $x$ where $c_x=1$ (and never restores $1$'s), until a fixed point is reached. A configuration $\beta\in\Omega$ is called stable if $\mathrm{BP}(\beta)=\beta$. Let
$$\mathcal{E}=\{\beta\in\Omega:\mathrm{BP}(\beta)=\beta\}$$
denote the set of stable configurations. For each $\beta\in\mathcal{E}$ with $\pi(\mathrm{BP}(\eta)=\beta)>0$, define
$$\pi_\beta(\,\cdot\,)=\pi\bigl(\,\cdot\,\bigm|\mathrm{BP}(\eta)=\beta\bigr).$$
(For atypical $\beta$, define $\pi_\beta$ as a regular conditional distribution of $\pi$ given the $\sigma$-algebra generated by $\mathrm{BP}$.)

Question. Let $\mu$ be any stationary probability measure for the KCM. Does there necessarily exist a probability measure $\mu^\ast$ on $\mathcal{E}$ such that
$$\mu=\int_{\mathcal{E}} \pi_\beta\, d\mu^\ast(\beta)\,?$$
Equivalently, is every stationary measure of the KCM a mixture of the conditional equilibrium measures $\pi_\beta$ indexed by stable configurations of the bootstrap percolation?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is stated as an open problem in recent surveys on kinetically constrained models. Partial results are known: stable configurations characterize ergodic components, and the conjectured decomposition has been verified for several specific KCM families (e.g. one-spin facilitated and non-cooperative models), but no proof in full generality is reported.

status_evidence.title: Kinetically constrained models (survey)
status_evidence.snippet: To understand the stationary measures of a KCM, two main ingredients are needed: the identification of ergodic components ... The stable configurations for the bootstrap percolation characterize the ergodic components of the KCM.
status_evidence.claim: The connection between stationary measures and bootstrap-percolation stable configurations is an active research direction with the general decomposition stated as a conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Kinetically constrained models out of equilibrium
status_evidence.snippet: analysis of stationary evolution... ergodic components... open problems remain
status_evidence.claim: General classification of stationary measures of KCMs remains an open problem.
